title: Forlorn Rowe

The '''Forlorn Rowe''' is located in northwestern [[Duskwood]], on the northern edge of [[Raven Hill Cemetery]]. It is a hill cloaked in an ominous darkness, upon which the home of [[Morbent Fel]] rests, the powerful necromancer who rules the forest's undead creatures through evil arcane magic. [[Alliance]]-aligned adventurers will need to do a lot of running and fighting in order to obtain the only [[Morbent's Bane|special weapon]] that could stop him.
